summary.text: Art Washut is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 36, serving since January 2019, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Art Washut was born in Casper, Wyoming, and earned an associate degree from Casper College and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Wyoming in 1994.
Washut's professional experience includes working as a police officer, police administrator and college instructor.
Washut's organizational affiliations include the St. Anthony Manor board and the Wyoming Medical Center Foundation Heroes' Fund Committee.
Washut assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 7, 2019, succeeding Debbie Bovee.
For 2025-2026, Washut chairs the House Judiciary Committee and the Joint Judiciary Committee and co-chairs the State Shooting Complex Oversight Task Force.
